title: Nazi Bell propulsion research at the Skoda Works under Kammler

tellings.quote: Nazi advanced propulsion research that was going on again at a facility called the SCOD works just outside Prague under the direction of SS General Hans Comler.

plain: During and after the Second World War, Nazi Germany is said to have run advanced propulsion research, the work behind a device called the Bell, at the Skoda Works just outside Prague, under SS General Hans Kammler. The researcher Jason Jorjani lays this out for Michels as a summary, drawing on a body of writing that includes Joseph P. Farrell, Nick Cook and Igor Witkowski and books titled The Hunt for Zero Point and Closer Encounters. If true, it would mean the Nazis were working on exotic flight technology far beyond ordinary aircraft.
